title: So much fun to...
text: So much fun to paddleboard and see Seville from the water! I love paddleboarding so would love to have additional time as 1.5 hours goes by quickly. Nacho is very knowledgeable and helped take a lot of photos as well which is a great keepsake. My hostel-mate and I were the only ones on that tour so we basically had our own private tour! Location is very easy to get to as well from Centro.
author: Ariel_L

title: Highly recommended for beginners
text: I totally liked it, and that was the first time I had ever gotten on, I recommend it; the water is very calm so there is nothing to fear
author: lideny_p

title: SUP - with Paddle Surf Seville - loved it!
text: Despite it being my first time, we had a fantastic experience.  The guide, Julio, was patient and informative not just about SUP but also about the city.  Would highly recommend this experience for a fun way to see Seville from the river.
author: Alison_G

title: So much fun! Great photos
text: We came as a group of 3 and Juan was so accommodating to our beginner experience level! We all had a lovely time and would recommend to anyone visiting the city. Such a fantastic experience!
author: Pioneer30950786274

title: Definitely recommend!
text: I had so much fun - the tour guide (Rodrigo) was very friendly, knowledgeable and helpful. It took a while to get my balance right and I fell in but it was hilarious and I felt very safe the whole time. Great to know some interesting facts about Sevilla too! 6pm. Was a perfect time to go.
author: Naomi_I

title: Sup at the top
text: It was cool, I'd never done SUP in my life and I have to say it was really cool. As well as the fact that the girl stopped to explain some things about Seville I really appreciated it then I recommend everyone to do it at sunset really a charm
author: Alessandro B

title: Great fun in the sun!
text:
We are a family of 4 visiting from the UK with no prior experience of Paddle boarding. This turned out to be a great activity to do with my wife and teenage sons. The guys at Paddle Surf Sevilla made us feel welcome and really looked after us. The premises was clean with changing facilities/toilet/shower, and the equipment was all in very good condition.
The activity itself took us in a loop on the river and our guide was full of local knowledge about iconic buildings etc... He also took several group/family photos which were sent to us at no extra charge!
It was lovely to spend some time havi
author: Trail11689349225

title: The family enjoyed our...
text:
The family enjoyed our tour with Tatiana. Tatiana was a great host and guide. The kids were a bit nervous about standing up on the boards but Tatiana was very patient and encouraging and worked to find ways to help the kids get over any fears. The paddle board tour was one of the highlights of our trip.

Tatiana also provided recommendations for places to visit and eat after the tour which were helpful.
author: Kenita_J

title: Great!
text: The tour guide was great! Great fun to sail on the canal! The weather was nice too. You could fall! But you can also change after the time!
author: lucasbP5980UG
